title: Cam's Vanilla+
body:
# **Cams Vanilla+**
Bring your world to life with Cams Vanilla+! CV+ brings a new and better feel to the 1.21.5 version of Vanilla Minecraft! Improving optimization, adding sublte features like shaders, enhanced visuals and animations like Actions & Stuff, and so much more allow you to be more immersed into your minecraft worlds! 

### **Better optimization:** 
Having frame drops when running vanilla minecraft? CV+ introduces a variety of performance mods to help improve the quality of the game. Alongside these performance enhancing mods are mods like sodium that allow for more control over your performance.

### **Better Visuals:** 
Ever feel like vanilla minecraft is a bit bland? CV+ fixes all of that! On top of shaders, added mods like hold my items, subtle effects, and texture packs like fresh animations, and actually 3D stuff make the game feel more vibrant and more immersive! 

### **Play With Friends:** 
Ever wanted to play with friends but not have to worry about paying for a server or realm? With the Essential mod inside of CV+ you can! The Essential mod allows players to share the Vanilla+ experience by hosting local worlds so friends can join alongside you!

### **A Great Alternative:** 
Looking for a great alternative to Bedrock's Actions & Stuff? Look no further! This pack includes various mods and resource packs to make the game look and feel similar to Bedrock's Actions & Stuff resource pack while staying true to java!

Ive put many hours into composing this modpack so giving it a download would mean the world to me tysm🙏
